events.command: python -m helpdesk.cli part1 --message "I forgot my PASSWORD." --variant original

update.reply: Recover access to the practice account [GUIDE-PASSWORD]: 1. Open the practice sign-in screen and choose Forgot password. 2. Follow the recovery instructions shown by the practice application. 3. If recovery is unavailable, prepare a ticket describing the error. 4. Never include a password or recovery code in a ticket.
